_doc: Music sourcing brief for music-forge. Bucket keys = the channel's CASUAL-COMEDIC mood taxonomy (spec 2026-07-11-phase3-music-lane-arc-design.md A1, Crayon-Capital idiom, NOT cinematic). Keys become audio-tokens.json music_pools keys; incompetech_seeds feed fetch_incompetech (CC-BY). dur_s = a loopable section length. This is the ONLY home for sourcing config; final beds live in audio/beds + music_pools.

casual-bed.mood_use: DEFAULT workhorse bed — wry, dry, laid-back groove (slightly noir/neutral, NOT cheerful) under most narration. Cheerful/bouncy is the 'upbeat' opt-in only; a super-cheerful bed under fraud/human-cost stories reads tonally wrong (register doctrine: default wry, cheerful opt-in).
clap_prompts: a laid-back bluesy noir detective-lounge groove
a smooth cool jazzy underscore that sits under narration

upbeat.mood_use: energetic playful lift — the fun/absurd money bits (still casual-comedic, not a fanfare)
clap_prompts: an upbeat cheerful playful comedic tune

sneaky.mood_use: light comedic tiptoe / mischief — the 'here's the con' stretches (quirky, NOT cinematic tension)
clap_prompts: a sneaky mischievous comedic tiptoe tune
